title: Nuevo Laredo to Offer 500 Free Shingles Vaccines Nov. 17, 18 and 20
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo will offer 500 free shingles vaccines at the Centro Cívico on Nov. 17, 18 and 20 for residents over 50 and people with health conditions that put them at risk.
content:
Nuevo Laredo will offer 500 free shingles vaccines next week at the Centro Cívico, a shot that many families could not otherwise afford, according to the municipal government.

The free vaccination drive runs Tuesday, Nov. 17, Wednesday, Nov. 18, and Friday, Nov. 20, from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Centro Cívico, according to the city's announcement, which was reported by multiple Tamaulipas outlets.

The vaccines are for people over 50 and for people with other health conditions who meet the medical criteria for the shot, according to the announcement. Shingles, known in Spanish as herpes zóster or culebrilla, is a painful rash caused by the same virus as chickenpox, and the vaccine is described by the city as high-cost and difficult for many families to buy on their own.

To get the vaccine, residents must bring a copy of their INE voter credential, front and back, and fill out a request letter at the Centro Cívico, according to the announcement. The 500 doses are available on a first-come basis while supplies last, according to Lado.mx, citing Hora Cero.

The drive is part of a city health push led by Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal, according to the announcement.

Source: Notiviza Noreste, November 15, 2026. Also reported by Lado.mx, Proyecto del Noreste and El Congresista.
